purpose: Read-only city parcel-source discovery; no runtime, global, catalog, or registry integration.
assessment: The state BhuNaksha portal is an interactive record selector; the official search-index page lists state, category, district, taluka, village and parcel-number controls. Web-reader access reports a redirect loop and direct HTTPS attempts timed out, so public locality access and a city vector route remain unverified.
registryAssessment: Official local corporation property-tax services include a Property Mapping link. This confirms a city property-map service, although its city-wide coverage and ability to view parcels without authentication are not established.
